raw_text: Yarn 3.4.1. Build: `yarn build:debug`; target: `yarn build --target <target-triple>`. Test: `yarn test __test__/index.spec.mjs` (build `index.node` first). Clients are stateful; create once/reuse. `removeListener/unSubscribe` are NOOPs. If build fails, ensure Rust toolchain is up to date: `rustup update stable && cargo update`
